### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Accurately report all specific objective findings, including any deviations from normal; do not generalize an exam as 'normal' if abnormal findings are present. Patient-reported symptoms, even if elicited during an exam, must be placed in the Subjective section.
[A-Section]: Ground all diagnoses and current patient status strictly in provider statements and objective findings. Do not introduce conditions explicitly contradicted by the transcript (e.g., 'no signs of dehydration'). Distinguish current assessments from future risks or advice given in the plan.
[Global]: Adhere strictly to the transcript for all factual claims; avoid inference or extrapolation beyond explicit statements.
